episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: What you're going to hear is a series of conversations that took place before Nicole published her recent New York Times article as she was trying to figure out in real time what she would write about all this.
I talked to Nicole and later I talked to Naja and she talks to her mom.
These are conversations throughout which I was so alert and on edge sometimes.
It is rare to hear a person who made a big influential argument come forward and say honestly, this is how it actually played out.
And then publicly face their teenager.
That's today's show, argument in five acts.
